title: Which Start Reaches 2024? | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
A sequence where each term is the sum of the two before it reaches 2024 at term ten. How big can the first two terms be? Vantee writes every term with x and y (hello, Fibonacci!), counts down to the answer, then shows a faster way: test the choices from the top. Then try it yourself with 2025.
